name: The Veiled Hour
injected_by: opencode (space-bunny-free) — session veiled-hour-2026-09-30. A pillar field cradling a star cluster that is never seen, authored entirely in OntoMath under the authority of Zach. No engine change was made to admit it: no new class, no new enum value, no new method.

qualities.veil.subject: emission and absorption — a pillar field around a hidden cluster

displayName.v: The Veiled Hour's Own Drift — the cavity, faintly, always

radiance.role.v: faint ambient of the whole Zone

displayName.v: The Cluster — collapsed, and never seen

radiance.role.v: the only source in the Zone

veil.falloff.v: 1/r^2, normalised; the law every pillar obeys

veil.doctrine.v: A Zone may be a place whose light you never see. Everything visible here is an argument about where this point is.

displayName.v: The Ionised Cavity — H-alpha red, OIII teal inside it

veil.chromaNote.v: OIII blend weight is flux^3, so doubly-ionised oxygen is a small teal heart inside a red H-alpha nebula. At flux^0.8 every radius came out a muddy half-and-half

veil.emissionNote.v: emission rises as flux^3, so the core blows out to white and the margins keep their colour

veil.transportNote.v: the volume pass takes a fixed 96 samples to the first opaque surface (SdfWgsl.cpp:3603), which is why this Zone is 105 m across and not 1 km: fine structure comes from D(p), not march resolution

displayName.v: The Cold Dust — the cluster's own shadow, made solid

veil.measuredNote.v: the shadow term is raised to 1.8 because a raw (1 - flux) was a 2.4x trend and Perlin overpowered it, leaving the dust DENSER near the cluster than far from it

displayName.v: The Pillar Rims — the ablation front, still cooking

veil.note.v: hugs the upper half of each pillar, where the ionising front is still eating it

displayName.v: The Reflection Haze — starlight off the dust, and the grain

veil.falloff.v: 1/(r+6) clamped — scattering is strongest near the source

veil.why.v: emission alone is smooth and reads as fog; the grain in this blue haze is what says 'dust'

radiance.role.v: scattering medium carrying a phase function

veil.conventionVerified.v: wi = normalize(worldP - source), wo = normalize(ro - worldP), so dot(wi,wo) = +1 is forward scattering (SdfWgsl.cpp:3649-3667). Verified by reading the transport, not assumed.

displayName.v: The Outer Veil — the background the nebula is seen against

veil.why.v: a bright object on pure black reads as a fog volume; a nebula is seen against something

displayName.v: Pillar 1 of 7 — ablated toward the cluster

veil.law.v: length grows with distance from the cluster: the 1/r^2 ionising flux has already eaten the near ends
